messages.subject: Handsontable inside Shiny
parts: Hope that in future versions of Shiny there will be an opportunity to modify data.frames in a way Handsontable (http://handsontable.com/) allows to. Often it is very useful to have a tool that allows to modify a reactive data.frame in this way. E.g. I use certain data that I downloaded from some website or any other source, which is not directly controlled, or I generated it myself in some way. I see that there are outliers or mistakes in the data and am willing to correct/re-scale them or remove entire rows from the data.frame before doing any analysis. At the moment I don't know an easy way to do it. Another use of it might be modifying some data stored in the database in a user-friendly way.
